response.actualMission: Mission: Identify the present cause of endpaper rippling before choosing a remedy or resuming atlas production.
response.finishLine: Completion boundary: The current defect is classified from reconciled evidence and an authorized remedy path is selected without false recurrence.
factualFindings: H03: The recurrence rule requires both the characteristic one-edge shape and an out-of-band roller measurement.
O02: Independent feeler readings place the roller gap inside its marked tolerance before and after the affected run.
O03: Unused endpaper from the same wrapped bundle curls immediately after unwrapping, before it reaches the press.
E04: A sealed remainder from an older paper bundle stays flat beside the curling new remainder in the same room.

response.actualMission: Determine whether each orchard zone has enough direct evidence for safe cover release after the cold night.
response.finishLine: Every named zone has a valid governed record or an authorized evidence-based disposition before its cover is removed.
factualFindings: H01: Cover release requires a valid under-cover minimum-temperature record for each named zone; a zone without that record remains unresolved.
H02: A surface or boundary reading outside a cover is a proxy observation and cannot substitute for the required under-cover minimum.
O02: The north ribbon's ink is washed blank across the overnight interval, so no north minimum can be read.
E03: The placement card locates the cold outside-edge thermometer beyond the north cover rather than beneath it.
E04: The release sheet has complete east and center entries and a blank controlling entry for the north zone.
inferences: A localized controlling-evidence gap for north-zone cover release, with proxy evidence that cannot determine the missing fact.
response.conclusion: East and center have direct release records, while north remains unresolved because its governing record is absent and the cold edge reading is only a proxy.
response.earliestSharedCausalBoundary: The lost north under-cover monitoring interval that leaves the required zone record blank.
response.completeDefectClass: A localized controlling-evidence gap for north-zone cover release, with proxy evidence that cannot determine the missing fact.
response.safeIndependentContinuation: Keep the north cover in place and request bounded horticultural authority for bud-section evidence and disposition.
response.smallestAdvancingAction: Keep the north cover in place and request bounded horticultural authority for bud-section evidence and disposition.
response.authorizationBasis: Existing authority permits: Maintain the north cover; Compile the supplied east and center records; Submit the north evidence gap to the horticultural lead. It does not permit: Remove the north cover; Cut north-zone buds without the horticultural lead's authority; Record the outside-edge proxy as an under-cover minimum.
prohibitedOperations: Remove the north cover
Cut north-zone buds without the horticultural lead's authority
Record the outside-edge proxy as an under-cover minimum
uncertainties: The north zone's actual under-cover minimum and bud condition are unknown.
response.boundedRationaleSummary: The governed rule requires a direct under-cover minimum for each zone. response.actualMission: Prepare serviceable mooring lines while preventing any line exposed to the damaged staging guide from use.
response.finishLine: Every G-2-contact line is fully inspected and dispositioned, and verified bypass lines proceed independently.
factualFindings: H02: Dock crews handle lines independently after staging, so a cause shared across docks must precede their dock assignments.
O02: Every glazed line's route card includes temporary guide ring G-2 during staging.
O03: Three lines assigned to the same docks bypassed G-2 and show no glazing under the same inspection method.
E01: A dated maintenance image shows a raised burr on G-2 at the height of the line contact path.
E03: Affected and unaffected lines came from overlapping fiber lots, while G-2 contact separates the two groups exactly.
inferences: Potential contact damage across every line routed through the burred G-2 surface, not merely the five visibly glazed lines.
response.conclusion: Guide contact, rather than dock crew, tension, or fiber lot, is the earliest boundary that exactly separates affected and control lines.
response.earliestSharedCausalBoundary: Contact with temporary guide ring G-2 during common staging before the lines separated by dock.
response.completeDefectClass: Potential contact damage across every line routed through the burred G-2 surface, not merely the five visibly glazed lines.
response.safeIndependentContinuation: Keep G-2 lines held, begin full-length inspection, and release only route-verified bypass lines.
response.smallestAdvancingAction: Keep G-2 lines held, begin full-length inspection, and release only route-verified bypass lines.
response.authorizationBasis: Existing authority permits: Keep all G-2-contact lines held; Inspect their full contact lengths; Release independently verified bypass lines. It does not permit: Return a G-2-contact line to service before full inspection; Grind or replace G-2 without maintenance authority; Hold a bypass line solely because it reached the same dock.
prohibitedOperations: Return a G-2-contact line to service before full inspection
Grind or replace G-2 without maintenance authority
Hold a bypass line solely because it reached the same dock
uncertainties: The depth of damage on each held line is not yet known.
response.boundedRationaleSummary: Two independent dock branches share only the G-2 contact, the route matrix separates glazed from clear controls, and the burr is documented on the matching contact path. The rule therefore scopes inspection to every exposed line while permitting independently verified bypass lines to proceed.

response.conclusion: Guide contact, rather than dock crew, tension, or fiber lot, is the earliest boundary that exactly separates affected and control lines.

response.actualMission: Prepare a fully accepted fair site while preserving the east-frame safety exclusion.
response.finishLine: All readiness tracks, including overhead clearance and final site acceptance, are complete before opening.
factualFindings: H03: Ground tasks outside the marked exclusion zone do not depend on overhead clearance.
O01: The east overhead frame has a bent connector and has been tagged out by the structural steward.
O02: Audience-path marking and volunteer briefing areas lie outside the measured exclusion zone.
E02: A scaled site card shows the exclusion boundary and the separate ground-route corridor.
E05: The site lead is authorized to conduct ground-route marking and brief volunteers in the west assembly area.
inferences: Localized overhead structural failure that blocks dependent east-section work but not separated ground-readiness tracks.
response.conclusion: East overhead work must stop, while route marking and west-area briefing may continue because their locations and dependencies are independently bounded.
response.earliestSharedCausalBoundary: The east overhead frame section at its bent connector, bounded by the steward's exclusion zone.
response.completeDefectClass: Localized overhead structural failure that blocks dependent east-section work but not separated ground-readiness tracks.
response.safeIndependentContinuation: Maintain the barriers and begin authorized ground-route marking outside the exclusion zone.
response.smallestAdvancingAction: Maintain the barriers and begin authorized ground-route marking outside the exclusion zone.
response.authorizationBasis: Existing authority permits: Maintain the east exclusion zone; Mark ground routes outside the zone; Brief volunteers in the west assembly area. It does not permit: Enter or work beneath the tagged frame; Open the fair before final site acceptance.
prohibitedOperations: Enter or work beneath the tagged frame
Open the fair before final site acceptance
uncertainties: The repair method and clearance time for the east frame are not yet known.
response.boundedRationaleSummary: The steward tag precisely bounds the unsafe area, while the site card and readiness sequence establish that two ground tasks are physically and procedurally independent. Continuing those authorized tasks advances the mission without entering the zone or confusing partial readiness with final acceptance.

response.actualMission: Produce an access docket containing the required surface-ventilation evidence while preventing unapproved cavern descent.
response.finishLine: Two witnessed surface readings are added at the prescribed interval and a materially complete docket receives an access decision before descent.
factualFindings: H01: The society names UNCHANGED_EXCEPTION_REQUEST_LOOP when a denied docket is resubmitted without the same expressly requested prerequisite evidence.
H02: Three prior dockets were denied because they lacked two witnessed surface-ventilation readings taken at the prescribed interval.
O01: The fourth draft repeats the prior mapping photographs and contains no ventilation reading.
E01: Each denial letter highlights the same missing two-reading prerequisite and does not request more mapping detail.
E02: A page comparison shows the fourth draft changes its cover note but adds no prerequisite evidence.
inferences: Repeated exception-request loop caused by resubmitting an unchanged evidence gap instead of collecting an authorized prerequisite.
response.conclusion: The fourth draft satisfies the named loop because it changes presentation but omits the same required readings after three explicit denials.
response.earliestSharedCausalBoundary: The unchanged docket assembly step that repeatedly omits the same prescribed ventilation evidence.
response.completeDefectClass: Repeated exception-request loop caused by resubmitting an unchanged evidence gap instead of collecting an authorized prerequisite.
response.safeIndependentContinuation: Keep the entrance sealed and take the first prescribed witnessed surface-ventilation reading.
response.smallestAdvancingAction: Keep the entrance sealed and take the first prescribed witnessed surface-ventilation reading.
response.authorizationBasis: Existing authority permits: Keep the entrance sealed; Collect the two prescribed surface readings; Append supported readings to a later docket. It does not permit: Resubmit the unchanged fourth draft; Descend before approval; Replace readings with additional mapping photographs.
prohibitedOperations: Resubmit the unchanged fourth draft
Descend before approval
Replace readings with additional mapping photographs
uncertainties: The future ventilation readings and access decision are not yet known.
response.boundedRationaleSummary: The named history rule requires an unchanged omission after denial, and all three denial letters plus the fourth draft establish exactly that pattern. Unlike another cover-note change, the already authorized surface measurement creates new controlling evidence while leaving the descent barrier intact.
